g.text: Protocol A.1; the structural-class contrast is not universal
C | Numerical eligibility is material- and tolerance-dependent

A. Paired archived and A.1 stability floors. B. Overall non-evaluable fractions at the three chemical contracts. C. A.1 non-evaluable fractions by analysis stratum. Non-evaluable means the reference Bader QoI is not independently resolvable at the requested tolerance and is neither a codec pass nor a codec failure.
The archived order-preserving float32 round trip is retained only as provenance; all current eligibility and certification use Protocol A.1.
